courses.overview: 由帶電、放電路徑與防護稽核延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend charging, discharge paths and control audits into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 表面黏著生產線
related.why: SMT 每個搬運環節都需要靜電控制。
related.whyEn: Every SMT handling transfer needs ESD control.
related.transfer: SMT 每個搬運環節都需要靜電控制。
related.transferEn: Every SMT handling transfer needs ESD control.
related.difference: 製程良率和 ESD 潛在損傷不同，初測通過不能排除後者。
related.differenceEn: Yield and latent ESD damage differ; initial passing cannot exclude the latter.
practice: 把「摩擦帶電」的概念圖與「表面黏著生產線」的輸入輸出對照。
將工作區物品分類為導電、耗散與絕緣。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：製程良率和 ESD 潛在損傷不同，初測通過不能排除後者。
practiceEn: Compare the triboelectric charging concept map with inputs/outputs of Surface-mount production lines.
Classify objects as conductive, dissipative or insulating.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Yield and latent ESD damage differ; initial passing cannot exclude the latter.

related.title: 汽車電子環境耐久驗證
related.why: ESD 與車用耐久都重視機制和證據。
related.whyEn: ESD and automotive durability both depend on mechanisms/evidence.
related.transfer: ESD 與車用耐久都重視機制和證據。
related.transferEn: ESD and automotive durability both depend on mechanisms/evidence.
related.difference: 器件 HBM/CDM 資格與整機端口及長期環境不同。
related.differenceEn: Device HBM/CDM qualification differs from product ports/long-term environment.
practice: 把「電容與電位」的概念圖與「汽車電子環境耐久驗證」的輸入輸出對照。
檢查系統量測紀錄與失效處置。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：器件 HBM/CDM 資格與整機端口及長期環境不同。
practiceEn: Compare the capacitance and potential concept map with inputs/outputs of Automotive-electronics environmental durability validation.
Review system measurements and failure response records.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Device HBM/CDM qualification differs from product ports/long-term environment.

courses.summary: 電子組件靜電防護以帶電、放電路徑與防護稽核連結元件、系統和驗證。此定位提供公開供應鏈或工程案例的地理背景。
courses.summaryEn: Electrostatic protection of electronic assemblies links components, systems and validation through charging, discharge paths and control audits. The location gives public supply-chain or case geography.
courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: EOS/ESD Association 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。接觸分離可轉移電荷，材料及濕度影響程度。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「帶電、放電路徑與防護稽核」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from EOS/ESD Association provides a traceable starting point. Contact/separation transfers charge; materials and humidity influence magnitude. Independently authored models connect this to charging, discharge paths and control audits; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：人體模型與器件帶電模型代表不同放電條件。 以「將分類電壓與各自模型配對，避免混比。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: HBM and CDM represent different discharge conditions. Practice interpretation using: Pair ratings with their models and avoid mixing them. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
